_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "full_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mobile" TEXT NULL, "company_name" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "national_id" TEXT NULL, "economic_id" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "search_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "price_rial" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "search_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "invoices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "number" TEXT NULL, "number_year" INTEGER NULL, "number_sequence" INTEGER NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (id), "issue_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NULL, "discount_rial" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "discount_percent_bp" INTEGER NULL, "tax_rate_bp" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "customer_name_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "customer_company_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "customer_national_id_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "customer_economic_id_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "customer_address_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL, "gross_total_rial" INTEGER NULL, "subtotal_rial" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_discount_rial" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_tax_rial" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "rounding_adjustment_rial" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "grand_total_rial" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "invoice_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "invoice_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "product_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES products (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "title_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_price_rial" INTEGER NOT NULL, "quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_rial" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "discount_percent_bp" INTEGER NULL, "resolved_tax_rate_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "line_gross_rial" INTEGER NULL, "allocated_invoice_discount_rial" INTEGER NULL, "line_net_rial" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "line_tax_rial" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "line_total_rial" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "invoice_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "amount_rial" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paid_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "method" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "default_tax_rate_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000, "rounding_unit_rial" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "payment_term_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30, "invoice_number_prefix" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INV', "device_prefix" TEXT NULL, "last_backup_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (singleton = 1));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_invoices_number ON invoices (number)
